content: जीवन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [जीव् भावे ल्युट्] Enlivening, giving life. .{@-नः@} .²1 A living being. .²2 Wind. .²3 A son. .²4 The Supreme Being; बीजानां प्रभव नमोऽस्तु जीवनाय <ls>Ki. 18. 39</ls>. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Life, existence; (<ab>fig.</ab> also) त्वमसि मम भूषणं त्वमसि मम जीवनम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>. .²2 The principle of life, vital energy; <ls>Bg. 7. 9</ls>. .²3 Water; बीजानां प्रभव नमोऽस्तु जीवनाय <ls>Ki. 18. 39</ls>; or जीवनं जीवनं (life) हन्ति प्राणान् हन्ति समीरणः <ls>Udb.</ls> .²4 Livelihood, profession, means of existence (<ab>fig.</ab> also); <ls>Ms. 11. 77</ls>; विदुषां जीवनं मूर्खः <ls>H. 3. 33</ls>. .²5 Butter made from milk one day old. .²6 Marrow. .²7 Enlivening, making alive.
